name: via_paddle_311
cfg:
home = C:\Python313
implementation = CPython
uv = 0.11.6
version_info = 3.13.7
include-system-site-packages = false

packages.name: aiohttp
requires: Brotli>=1.2; (platform_python_implementation == "CPython" and sys_platform != "android" and sys_platform != "ios") and extra == "speedups"
backports.zstd; (platform_python_implementation == "CPython" and python_version < "3.14" and sys_platform != "android" and sys_platform != "ios") and extra == "speedups"

packages.name: huggingface-hub
requires: hf-xet<2.0.0,>=1.1.3; platform_machine == "x86_64" or platform_machine == "amd64" or platform_machine == "arm64" or platform_machine == "aarch64"

packages.name: opencv-contrib-python
requires: numpy >=1.21.0 ; python_version <= "3.9" and platform_system == "Darwin" and platform_machine == "arm64"
numpy >=1.19.3 ; python_version >= "3.6" and platform_system == "Linux" and platform_machine == "aarch64"

packages.name: paddlex
requires: decord==0.6.0; ((platform_machine == "x86_64" or platform_machine == "AMD64") and sys_platform != "darwin") and extra == "video"
decord==0.6.0; ((platform_machine == "x86_64" or platform_machine == "AMD64") and sys_platform != "darwin") and extra == "base"

packages.name: scikit-image
requires: pyamg>=5.2; sys_platform != "emscripten" and python_version < "3.14" and extra == "optional"
